description:
Upgrade your ride with OEDRO Running Boards—where rugged durability meets sleek style. Designed for effortless access, they make getting in and out of your truck Pickup while shielding your vehicle from road debris. With a bold, off-road-ready look and precision-built toughness, these running boards enhance safety, style, and convenience. Built to last and easy to maintain, they're the perfect upgrade for both adventurers and daily drivers.
Features
Custom Fit for your Truck: Precisely engineered for 2015-2026 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab & 2017-2026 Ford F-250 F-350 Super Duty Crew Cab, ensuring a seamless fit that complements your vehicle's factory styling and functionality.
Innovative Two-Stair Design: Features a convenient 3.5-inch drop step and a wide 6.8-inch stepping surface, making entry and exit easier for lifted Jeeps, children, elderly passengers, and daily drivers.
Heavy-Duty Carbon Steel Construction: Built from high-strength carbon steel with reinforced mounting brackets, supporting up to 550 lbs per side for reliable strength and long-term durability.
Anti-Slip Surface for All-Weather Safety: The perforated step plate design improves traction while allowing water, snow, mud, and debris to drain away, providing secure footing in any weather condition.
No-Drill Bolt-On Installation: Installs directly to factory mounting locations without drilling or modifications. Includes all necessary hardware for a fast and hassle-free installation.
1-Year Warranty | Professional installation is highly recommended for safety.

highlights: These OEDRO running boards feature a 3.5" drop step and 6.8" wide angular steel tube, delivering enhanced accessibility, aggressive off-road styling, and improved ground clearance balance.

Built with heavy-duty triangular carbon steel construction and a corrosion-resistant powder-coated finish, each side supports up to 550 lbs, ensuring exceptional strength, stability, and long-term durability under extreme driving conditions.

Engineered for all-weather safety and convenience, the perforated anti-slip surface prevents water, snow, and debris buildup, while the bolt-on, no-drill installation with factory mounting points ensures a fast, secure, and hassle-free setup.
